# Copilot Instructions

The authoritative AI instructions for this project are in **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository root.

Read that file before answering any question or making any change to this repository.
It contains the project overview, repository structure, frontmatter schema, writing guidelines,
development workflow, and quality checklist.
